description: Photoshopped meme depicting Obama-era officials and Democratic figures behind prison bars, framed as viewed from inside a cell. Recognizable faces include Robert Mueller, Adam Schiff, Hillary Clinton, Huma Abedin, James Clapper, James Comey, Loretta Lynch, John Brennan, Barack Obama, Eric Holder, and Bill Clinton. The caption asserts the Russia collusion investigation is a 'proven lie' and asks when treason trials will begin.
text: NOW THAT RUSSIA COLLUSION IS A PROVEN LIE, WHEN DO THE TRIALS FOR TREASON BEGIN?
flags: Meme asserts the unadjudicated claim that Russia collusion is a 'proven lie' and implies the pictured figures committed treason; carried as the meme's claim only
One or two background faces are partially obscured and left unidentified

description: Screenshot of a verified @WhiteHouse tweet from December 11, 2018, stating 'Border security is national security.' The embedded video still shows Kellyanne Conway, Counselor to the President, in a Fox News interview outside the White House, with a chyron about Trump meeting Pelosi and Schumer on border-wall funding to avoid a government shutdown. Its wording echoes Q drop 2502's 'Border Security = National Security', which is why it circulated as a Q proof.
